steps.title: Digest DNA with MboI
steps.instruction: Add Mbo I enzyme (New England Biolabs) to the DNA sample to perform restriction digestion.

steps.title: Biotinylated fill‑in reaction
steps.instruction: Add 10 mM each of dCTP, dGTP, and dTTP, 0.4 mM biotin‑14‑dATP, and DNA Polymerase I (Large Klenow Fragment) at 5 U/µL (New England Biolabs) to the digested DNA and incubate under the appropriate conditions.

steps.title: Proximity ligation
steps.instruction: Add 10X NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer, 10 % Triton X‑100, 10 mg/mL BSA, and T4 DNA ligase (New England Biolabs) to the fill‑in reaction and carry out ligation.

steps.title: Reverse crosslink and bead purification
steps.instruction: Add proteinase K (10 mg/mL, New England Biolabs) and 1 % SDS (Ambion) to the ligation tube, incubate at 56 °C overnight. Then split the reverse‑crosslinked DNA equally into three tubes, add 1.5× volume of AMPure XP beads, vortex, brief spin, incubate 10 min at room temperature, place on magnetic plate for 5 min, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, air‑dry completely, and resuspend beads in 30 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: Add repair enzyme mix
steps.instruction: Add 10X NEB T4 DNA ligase buffer containing 10 mM ATP, 25 mM dNTP mix, 10 U/µL NEB T4 PNK, 3 U/µL NEB T4 DNA polymerase I, and 5 U/µL NEB DNA polymerase I (Large Klenow Fragment) to the purified DNA.

steps.title: End‑repair with Klenow exo‑minus
steps.instruction: Add 10X NEBuffer 2, 10 mM dATP, and 5 U/µL NEB Klenow exo‑minus (New England Biolabs) to the reaction.

steps.title: Barcode ligation and PCR
steps.instruction: Add 10X T4 PNK Reaction Buffer, 100 mM ATP, 600 U/µL T4 DNA ligase, 50 % PEG8000, and 50 µM Ad153 barcode oligo_2B mix (BGI, Shenzhen, China). Then perform PCR: 95 °C 3 min; 8 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 60 °C 15 s, 72 °C 15 s; final extension 72 °C 10 min.
